environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached to ALB with the following managed rule groups enabled in BLOCK mode: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet (with SizeRestrictions_BODY rule action override to COUNT), AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet. The KnownBadInputsRuleSet includes rule JavaDeserializationRCE_BODY and rule Host_localhost_HEADER and rule ExploitablePaths_URIPATH and rule Log4JRCE_BODY. Additionally, a custom WAFv2 rule with priority 0 inspects JSON body field 'payload' using a regex pattern set matching common Python/Ruby/PHP code execution patterns including '__import__', 'eval(', 'exec(', 'os.system', 'subprocess', 'open(' with action BLOCK. TextTransformation applied: URL_DECODE, followed by LOWERCASE, followed by JS_DECODE. Request body inspection limit set to 64KB. The WebACL default action is ALLOW.

config.network: private subnet, ALB in public subnet
config.runtime: Python 3.11 on ECS Fargate, task role has no ssm:SendCommand
